title: Reading spread, delivered
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /insights/deliverability-is-infrastructure · the note on paper
summary: The approved note (P07) as a reading page: the standfirst at 24px across cols 3–10, the reading column in cols 3–8 at 18px, the margin in cols 10–12 holding only sources and ‘What to look for’ in Mona, and one figure where the argument turns — ‘Delivered isn't arrived’ (approved; the model for the interior's artifacts): the illustrative tile reads Delivered 100 of 100; the same 100 sends as they landed (Validity 2024 global average: 83.5 inbox · 6.7 spam · 9.8 missing), each value under its segment; red = missing. Rule 7 is said once: ‘Specimen’, one word in the key voice at the end of the figure's label row, and one plain line in the foot (the mono caps chip is gone).
story: The argument itself, verbatim. Round 9 removes the apparatus that read as generated (glyph sidebars, caps note heads, boxed numerals, mono source links, the end square) and moves the source list into the margin only (the separate Sources section is cut, so each source is said once).

reference.site: Approved P07 (round 8) · Tailscale's blog article for the long-form measure
reference.borrowed: A long-form reading column with its sidenotes in a margin, one wide figure that breaks the column once.
reference.kelwin: Paper as the note's document surface; Mona everywhere but the numerals; the kit's segmented control, label and spec list.

motion: entrance: the reading column arrives with its slot; the figure plays once when 40% of it is in view (its own IntersectionObserver).

copy: Body [K] verbatim (approved P07), with the standfirst moved here from the head

‘The floor, specified’ [K] as .ac-spec--key (Mona sentence-case keys instead of mono caps)

phone: ≤1023: the column takes cols 1–8 and the margin cols 9–12; the deliverability values set side by side, then stacked. ≤767: one column, each margin note right after its paragraph, the standfirst 20px, reading 17px. No overflow at 834 / 390 / 320; nothing under 11px.
notes: A reading surface, taller than the 1400px cap by design (the whole note). Margin notes take their own grid rows (the sources span rows 2–4, ending before the figure's full-width row); ‘What to look for’ spans into empty trailing rows, so the paper always contains it. Stress-tested with notes grown 4×. Coherence pass 3: the figure's numerals step down on tablets (44 / 36 / 26) and phones (34 / 30 / 22) so they stay under the note's h1 (52px at 834, 38 on phones). The note's text is unchanged. Final check: the cascade had undone that step (an older phone ‘__vn {36px}’ later in the ≤767 block, and the ≤1023 ‘__vn’ overriding the ≤1199 ‘__vn--s’). The stale rule is deleted and ‘__vn--s’ now follows ‘__vn’ in both blocks. Measured on the stitch: 1440 56/44/28/28 · 1100 and 1024 56/44/26/26 · 834 and 768 44/36/26/26 · 390, 360 and 320 34/30/22/22. On phones no value outranks the 100% tile; on tablets 6.7% and 9.8% stay under 83.5%.
